create_Block_bijector: create a Block bijector wrapping a scalar bijector with ndims to promote batch dimensions to event dimensions
run_Block_forward: run the Block bijector forward method to compute y = f(x) on multi-dimensional event arrays
run_Block_inverse: run the Block bijector inverse method to compute x = f inverse of y on multi-dimensional arrays
run_Block_forward_log_det_jacobian: run the Block bijector forward_log_det_jacobian to compute log determinant summed over last ndims dimensions
run_Block_forward_and_log_det: run the Block bijector forward_and_log_det to compute both the forward transform and its log det Jacobian
